mapper.insert: INSERT INTO twelve_exchange_review (order_id, reviewer_id, reviewee_id, score, content, create_time, tenant_id) VALUES (#{review.orderId}, #{review.reviewerId}, #{review.revieweeId}, #{review.score}, #{review.content}, NOW(), #{tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM twelve_exchange_order o WHERE (o.owner_a_id = #{userId} OR o.owner_b_id = #{userId}) AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.complete_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS completedOrders30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM twelve_exchange_order o WHERE (o.owner_a_id = #{userId} OR o.owner_b_id = #{userId}) AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS totalOrders30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM twelve_exchange_order_log l WHERE l.operator_id = #{userId} AND l.action IN ('cancel', 'dispute') AND l.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND l.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS directPenaltyCount30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM twelve_exchange_order_log l JOIN twelve_exchange_order o ON o.id = l.order_id WHERE l.action IN ('timeout', 'admin_force_cancel') AND (o.owner_a_id = #{userId} OR o.owner_b_id = #{userId}) AND l.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND l.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS systemPenaltyCount30d, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.score), 1) FROM twelve_exchange_review r WHERE r.reviewee_id = #{userId} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS avgScore, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM twelve_exchange_review r WHERE r.reviewee_id = #{userId} AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS reviewCount
